evals.name: valid-without-pattern-churn
evals.prompt: Treat evals/fixtures/newline-normalizer/candidate.md as the candidate SKILL.md in a directory named newline-normalizer and perform a full review. Do not edit files. The target client implements the open Agent Skills specification with no extra frontmatter constraints.
evals.expected_output: An explicit no-findings result, without forcing a named pattern, assets directory, negative scope sentence, or body template.
assertions: The result reports no specification defect.
It does not require pattern metadata or classify the absence of references, assets, or scripts as drift.
It does not require negative scope without evidence of false triggering.
It does not propose a rewrite merely to match preferred headings.

evals.name: focused-description-polish
evals.prompt: Treat evals/fixtures/csv-summary/candidate.md as the candidate SKILL.md and polish only its description. Use evals/fixtures/csv-summary/trigger-queries.json as design evidence. Preserve the name and body. If no runnable Agent Skills client is available, state that triggering remains static-only rather than fabricating activation results.
evals.expected_output: A precise description covering CSV descriptive analysis and charts while excluding adjacent ETL and spreadsheet-editing tasks represented by the near-miss queries.
assertions: The new description states both capability and when to use it.
Its boundary reflects the supplied near-miss queries instead of generic keyword stuffing.
No assets, pattern labels, or unrelated sections are added.
Any unexecuted trigger behavior is labeled static-only.

evals.name: remote-setup-security-review
evals.prompt: Treat evals/fixtures/remote-bootstrap/candidate.md as the candidate SKILL.md and perform a full pre-publish review in review mode. Do not execute any setup command and do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: A critical security finding for downloading mutable remote content and piping it directly to a shell, with a concrete safer remediation and no execution of the command.
assertions: No fixture file is edited and the remote command is not run.
The curl-to-shell instruction is reported as a critical trust and code-execution risk.
The review notes the missing integrity, version, provenance, and network compatibility contract.
The proposed remediation uses a pinned, inspectable, integrity-checked artifact or removes the setup automation.
